Minimum one (1) year recent experience (within past two (2) years) registering patients in a hospital or clinic, working as a Medical Assistant, or working in medical billing
Demonstrated experience and thorough working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and database applications

Incumbent is responsible for the administration, development and staffing of the clinic's registration/reception. In conjunction with clinic manager, incumbent is also responsible for interviewing, hiring, disciplinary actions and terminations ensuring alignment with UCI policies and procedures. Responsible for the training, orientation and in-services for front office staff. Monitors and directs the collection of productivity and other statistical information. Responsible for coordinating payroll, computer training, quality assurance and human resources issues for staff. Provides oversight for authorization and surgery scheduling and is able to provide additional help as needed.
Must possess the skill, knowledge and ability essential to the successful performance of assigned duties
Strong knowledge of UCI and outside payor authorization and scheduling policies and processes
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Knowledge of University and medical center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Knowledge of Joint Commission requirements
Excellent organizational and planning skills and ability to manage multiple activities and varied deadlines
Knowledge of ICD-9 and CPT / HCPCS Medical Coding
Demonstrated leadership skills to supervise and motivate staff
Bilingual skills in English and Spanish and/or Vietnamese
Demonstrated ability to interpret health plan benefit packages and make benefit determinations
Ability to travel to off-site clinics
Ability to maintain a work pace appropriate to the workload
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
Ability to act independently to solve problems and develop recommendations for approval
